# Changelog version 3.1.2

## Changed

* The profile directory has received some changes:

results.title: What’s so different about roleplaying in WoW Classic?
excerpts:
Heck, we even know how this story ends, with a return through the Dark Portal to Outland — although we won’t actually get to go there. However, it’s been a long, long time since we’ve seen old-world Azeroth. If you’re a roleplayer looking for a little refresher course in _Classic_ RP, you’ve come to the right place.

## Addons

Right now, the pickings for RP addons are pretty slim – you can expect them to stay that way. The only two profile-exclusive RP addons currently available are [MyRoleplay Classic](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/myroleplay-classic) , and [Total RP 3: Classic](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/total-rp-3-classic) . Both will get the job done, although Total RP 3 has a few more bells and whistles.

However, keep in mind that this situation may change a little, depending on how Blizzard is handling other addon cases. Currently, adjustments are being made to [prevent an LFG-style addon](https://blizzardwatch.

...

Get to know your fellow roleplayers, because everyone’s got a story to tell – and in a world that never really ages, those stories are what’s going to keep the gameplay fresh, thriving, and ultimately fun.

# MyRolePlay Classic

MyRolePlay Classic

Client Version: 1.15.2

* * *

Rating:

**The popular roleplaying addon returns for WoW Classic!**

_Do note this is still a work in progress, and some features are incomplete. More will be added before launch._

— From the MyRolePlay live version description page —

MyRolePlay is a roleplaying AddOn for World of Warcraft, developed by Etarna and Katorie . It allows you to make a profile about your character that other users of MyRolePlay (Or addons utilising the “Mary Sue Protocol”) can read, both in a tooltip preview and in its entirety within the profile viewer. The addon is designed to be both efficient and lightweight, consuming the fewest amount of resources possible, while providing most of the features a roleplayer would desire.

**Features**

* Further describe your character with the improved description and history fields.
They now fully support HTML text capabilities over the old editboxes, giving you control over text alignment, colours, font size, etc. You can even add icons and images and insert clickable hyperlinks.

* Spot other roleplayers at a glance, see which RP AddOns they are using, and get a quick overview of their character in the tooltip!

* Change your character’s name and name colour, allowing for last names, titles, etc.

* Change your character’s roleplay race or class. These will replace your normal race / class in the tooltip, if you choose.

* Tell others what your character is up to, using the currently field, and give some information on your RP details, using the new OOC/Other Information field.

* Give a preview of certain aspects of your character using the “At a Glance” field. (5 icons / small paragraphs players can mouseover to see short bits of information). There’s even a preview box so you don’t have to open the entire profile!
* Describe your character’s personality using the new personality tab. It includes a graphical bar interface that you can fully customise and visually describe how your character feels.

* Add an icon to your profile and tooltip that describes you best. (Maybe crossed swords? A cake for a baker, etc) Blizzard’s entire icon set is available for use.

* Add music to your profile, to give your character a theme! You can choose from any music file in the game.
* Add a private note to other’s profiles, that only you can see, and reference back to later.

* Set your character’s relationship status! (Single? Taken? Married? etc)

* Mark your preferred style of roleplaying (casual, full–time, beginner, or a custom style…), or your status (in character, out of character, being a storyteller…)

* Exercise your creativity further—describe your character’s appearance! Eye colour, height, weight – use the description field if you would like to write up something detailed.
* Give people a taste of your character’s story, if you wish—add biographical information like their age, hometown, birthplace, and maybe even some tidbits of history to make people hungry to discover more by interacting with your character and roleplaying with you. Or hide others’ biography, if you prefer to discover that kind of thing through interaction.

* Create multiple profiles per character, and automatically switch between them (if you’d like) when changing gear sets or shapeshift / druid forms. (Name the profile after the equipment set or form).

**Editing your profiles**

Bring up the character panel (“C” by default), and select the MyRolePlay tab underneath. Click on a field to edit it.

[+] button to add an alternate profile.  
[-] button to delete the currently selected profile.  
[R] button to rename the current profile.  
The drop down box allows you to change between profiles.
Fields that appear dimmed out are ‘inherited’ from the default profile—click to edit them if you wish.

The options panel allows you to customise the appearance and functionality of the addon to suit your needs. You can access it via the cogwheel icon on the editor, or by typing /mrp options in the chat box.

**Where can I see other people’s details?**

When you mouseover someone who has MyRolePlay (or another compatible addon), you’ll see some of the extra roleplaying details they added in the tooltip.

Want more information about their character than the tooltip provides, like the full description or history (where applicable)? To open the full profile viewer you may:

Target them and click on the “MRP” information button that appears by the target frame.  
Set a key combination in Key Bindings (under AddOns).  
Use the slash command: /mrp show <charactername> or just /mrp show when you have someone targeted.

...

**\*\*It is vital that you do not delete the “WTF” folder in your WoW directory without backing it up first if you wish to keep your profiles. This includes reinstallation of the game, troubleshooting, etc. Addons save their information here, and removing this folder WILL result in data loss.\*\***

**I can’t read another player’s profile, or they cannot read mine**  
At present, addons cannot communicate cross-server or faction (except for merged realms), unless you are Battle.net friends with the other player. It’s a technical limitation within the game that we as addon developers have no control over. MyRolePlay is ready for cross-server support if it ever is added. If you are not playing on an RP realm, chances are you will not see many players with RP addons. Try a realm with a high population of roleplayers, such as Moon Guard, Wyrmrest Accord (NA), or Argent Dawn (EU).

**I updated to a new version, but the new feature you added is blank for everyone else**

I roleplay a lot on classic servers, and I've been looking into this addon recently. It would be amazing to roleplay with the numerous new things given specifically by this addon and would add an amazing new mix of interesting possibilities for how roleplay is done on classic servers. I don't speak for the RP community on the classic servers, but I personally know numerous people who would absolutely love to use this addon (and perhaps see it as a requirement in addition to the base TRP3 addon).
  
  Would it be possible to bring this addon to Classic WoW? Having a new set of tools would be absolutely fantastic.
